newsitem.title: USA: FCB Financial closes OSB Financial merger.
newsitem.headline: FCB Financial closes OSB Financial merger.

text.p: FCB Financial Corp said Friday it completed a merger with OSB Financial Corp creating a financial institution with $528 million in assets, $400 million in loans and $317 million in deposits.

The merger was structured as a tax-free, stock-for-stock transaction and accounted for as a purchase transaction. Holders of OSB Financial common stock will receive 1.46 shares of FCB Financial common stock for each OSB Financial common share they own. Holders of FCB Financial common stock will hold the same number of the corporation's shares as prior to the merger. Shares of FCB Financial common stock will continue to trade on the NASDAQ stock market.
FCB Financial offers retail and business banking at 13 offices located in Oshkosh, Neenah, Appleton, Berlin, Darboy, Menasha, Ripon, Wautoma and Winneconne.
